notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.42 and later; returns statistics for the selected account. display is a required pre-serialized pipe-delimited string, sent once with normal query encoding. Some display values depend on server configuration; no array serialization is inferred.

Optional infinityimg, infinitylang, rowcounter and warninglevel have pinned null defaults and remain omitted when not supplied. warnings=true selects only values exceeding warninglevel, while warnings=false requests all results. warnout=true includes results at 100 percent; false hides them. The client encodes these supplied booleans as integer 1 or 0.

All result fields are optional. Count and maximum display values, including _count and _max, remain strings with their formatting intact. Result flags remain integer 0 or 1; zeroisunlimited explains whether zero means unlimited or zero for that statistic. condition is returned only when the statistic meets subsystem installation requirements. Preserve units per row rather than assuming one unit across statistics.
The pinned second response example contains langkey without declaring it in the formal item properties. It remains an unmodeled field and is not added to the typed contract from an example alone.

The original 2026-10-31-resource-statistics.json capture at fb4f9c9eb03e094d89a41806e927c4cbf0c60432 on cPanel 11.138.0.19 observed numeric strings at $[].percent through both routes. The pinned field is integer, so only canonical bounded integer strings normalize losslessly; native floats and fractional or noncanonical strings remain rejected. The structural capture does not reveal precise spelling or fractional formatting, which remains an unresolved live compatibility limit. No percentage string is cast through float or rounded, and neighboring percentage fields and flags are unchanged.
